versions.changelog: Add explicit tool metadata and provenance details to improve safety/provenance signaling.
Add reply/reply-all/forward guidance, attachment support, and refresh skill docs.

- Added support and documentation for deleting and moving emails, as well as full mail folder management (list, create, delete).
- Expanded description and trigger phrases to include actions like "delete email", "move email", "mail folders", "create folder", and "organize email".
- Updated workflow examples and mail command references to show new delete, move, and folder management commands.
- Security section now explicitly covers confirmation for email deletion.
- Minor clarifications on feature coverage for work accounts.

**Skill renamed and reorganized for corporate work accounts with improved clarity and onboarding.**

- Renamed skill to "m365-work" to clarify it covers only Microsoft 365 work/school (not personal) accounts.
- Added comprehensive prerequisites, authentication steps, and conventions for enterprise use.
- Incorporated user search and clarified SharePoint availability and permission requirements.
- Enhanced security guidance: do not output full email content unless explicitly requested; never handle credentials unsafely; summarize sensitive data.
- Split basic workflow and command examples by domain (email, calendar, OneDrive, SharePoint) and moved full syntax to a new `references/commands.md` file.
- Expanded trigger list for broader intent coverage (e.g., "work calendar", "organization users").
- Documentation is clearer on scope boundaries and security best practices.

- Fixed skill metadata: corrected the skill name from "m365clicli" to "m365cli" in SKILL.md.
- No functional changes to commands or behavior.

- Skill name changed from "m365" to "m365clicli" in SKILL.md.
- trusted-senders.txt sample file removed.
- No command, feature, usage, or security rule changes in documentation.
- No code changes described.
Update SKILL.md arguments to match m365-cli v0.1.6 and add anti-phishing rule

Initial release of the m365 skill for Microsoft 365 CLI integration.

- Enables sending, reading, and searching emails, with a trusted sender whitelist for email body security.
- Supports calendar event management: list, create, update, delete.
- Provides OneDrive file operations: browse, upload, download, share, invite, delete.
- Adds SharePoint access: list sites, files, lists, download/upload/search.
- Dedicated authentication flow with device code and stored tokens.
- JSON output supported for all commands; thoroughly documented security confirmations for sensitive actions.
